useCases: A homeschool writing table that needs one small scene before a full story
A tutoring or co-op desk where writers can choose one paper scene card at a time
A family writing warm-up where pointing, sketching, and one blank can start the page

parentSteps: Choose one scene routine before the activity starts.
Set the paper, pencil, sketch, and imagination rule before writing begins.
Let the writer point, sketch, dictate, write one word, or fill one blank before asking for a full sentence.
Turn one broad pretend view into a make-believe story clue rather than recording private information.
Send home one scene slip with a single finish blank so families can continue the story offline.
